title: Business English Conversation 20:  Getting an Upgrade
content: 1. to be on hold: to be waiting to talk to a person on the phone - I need to talk to someone in customer service, but I have been on hold for 45 minutes. - I hate it when I am on hold. 2. to get an upgrade: to get a better version of something - We got an upgrade at the hotel. They gave us a suite. - The rental car agency made a mistake with our reservation, so we got a free upgrade. 3. a supervisor: a manager or boss who watches and makes sure work is being done correctly - My supervisor is not nice. - Her supervisor yells at the employees. Everybody hates him.
